description: GitHub #262 / DCA 0105. Three images on one page, arranged so the recomposite's write-back target is DETERMINISTICALLY the wrong (occluded) one: a 1200x1200 base at Rect(51,51,561,651) which is by far the largest by pixel area, a 300x300 decoy at Rect(400,100,472,172) that shares dimensions with the third, and a 300x300 top image at Rect(80,470,224,614) drawn LAST over the base and carrying the edited invisible OCR span. Region-aware selection bails out on the dimension tie, the fallback picks the base, and the top image paints over the result -- the one arrangement in which the pre-write occlusion check can fire. Generated by generate_render_oracle_fixtures.py::make_occluded_write_target_page.
